title: Arizona toddler, 2, wanders into desert wearing only a diaper; volunteer finds her alive under bush
summary_full: A two-year-old girl named Vella Campillo vanished from her home in Eloy, Arizona, prompting an extensive search by volunteers and officials in the chilly desert for several hours. After more than five hours of searching, neighbor Jay Stewart found her hiding under a bush. Emergency responders ensured the girl's safety and promptly took her to a hospital for evaluation. Authorities classified this incident as a case of a wandering child.
